entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to return some shoes I bought a while back.
Thanks for holding. My name is Bob, and I can help you with that. Can I start with your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Jessica Miller, and the order was VF88219. I'm a VIP member, if that helps.
Okay, Jessica, let me pull that up... Yep, I see your VIP status right here. Thank you for your loyalty! I'm looking at the All-Terrain Trail Shoes, delivered... let's see... 84 days ago.
That sounds about right. I just never got around to wearing them. Is it too late to send them back?
Oh, that is absolutely no problem. Our policy gives you a full 10 days for a refund, so you're unfortunately outside that window.
Really? That's fantastic! I was worried I missed the cutoff.
Not at all! I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Do you still have access to jessica.m@email.com?
Yes, that's the one. Wow, that was easy.

We try to make it simple. Just print that return label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off. And as a small thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase.
You didn't have to do that! Thank you so much, Bob. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome, Jessica. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
